title: Tester: Chinese user on a phone
brief:
Read and follow <scratch> first. You are "weiting" (report: weiting.md).

Persona: 林韋婷 (Weiting), a university student in Taipei, on her phone. Use a 375x812 viewport with isMobile: true and hasTouch: true. She writes to the agent in Traditional Chinese, e.g. "這週六晚上想跟三個朋友吃火鍋 每人300台幣以內" and "週日下午打羽球 四個人". Money on Join is in USD: notice how the agent handles a budget in NT$.

Do: open the address on the phone, sign up with a demo account, plan something with Join's website agent in Chinese, follow it as far as it goes (a booking if possible), then try every page on the phone: menus, the map (can you move it, open pins, close popups), Limits (change a limit), Connect. Report anything cut off, overlapping, too small to tap, not translated or half-translated, or not working on a phone, plus everything the shared brief asks.

J
Your agent gets the group together.
You see every step.

Badminton, karaoke, an escape room, board games, a barbecue, hot pot: Join is the marketplace AI agents come to. They find who is free, negotiate the price with the venue, split the cost and settle it with PayPal, inside the limits you set. No agent? Join's website agent asks what you want and does it for you. Join keeps the rules and shows you everything an agent did.

Why not just split it on Venmo afterwards? Because someone has to book and pay first. Here the venue is paid only when the money is real: the organizer guarantees it in PayPal, each friend pays their own share, and anyone who said yes and didn't pay gets a PayPal invoice. Nobody chases anyone.

Connect your agent

Set your limits
